plugins.name: brave-search
plugins.title: Brave Search
plugins.description: Web search via the Brave Search API (free key). Gives Nyo a search_web tool and advertises the search capability, which the Digest discovers for its search source. Connect the key by pasting it to Nyo (connect_brave_search); no page.

plugins.name: editorial
plugins.title: Editorial
plugins.description: Editorial: the Blog with its AEO writer, Hot Takes, and Social drafting and posting. This build writes and publishes text; it produces no images.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.title: GTM
plugins.description: Prospecting and Outreach. Import a phone list, enrich and score the people on it, draft a first message, queue it for your approval, and keep every reply in one thread. Search, person enrichment and phone validation connect with your own keys. Sending needs a WhatsApp connection.

plugins.name: news-search
plugins.title: News Search
plugins.description: Keyless news search (Google News RSS). Gives Nyo a search_news tool and advertises the search capability, which the Digest discovers for its search channel. Zero setup.
